predicate.label: advances legislative measures through body
predicate.definition: Political actor X advances a legislative measure through legislative body Y.
includes: explicit pushing or advancing legislation through Y
excludes: gaining control of or taking over the body
ordinary membership, lobbying or communication without advancing a measure
ambiguous: push-through with the legislative object omitted
predicate.notes: The legislation is a third role and must be locally recoverable; bare push-through does not identify the measure or guarantee passage.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit pushing or advancing legislation through Y; historical legislative action. Excludes: gaining control of or taking over the body; ordinary membership, lobbying or communication without advancing a measure; physical movement through a building. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: push-through with the legislative object omitted; unclear proposer or legislative body; prospective intent without established action. The legislation is a third role and must be locally recoverable; bare push-through does not identify the measure or guarantee passage.

rationale: Push-through11 toward Congress defines legislative advancement family; missing measure objects must remain unresolved, and control/takeover separate.
